debit.notes: 24x7 toll-free customer care. Mobile Banking: Menu > My Cards > Debit > select card > Card Lock > OTP. Internet Banking: same path (My Cards > Debit > Card Lock > OTP). Credit/Debit: immediately report loss/theft/misuse on the 24x7 toll-free helpline.
